I can't give you that number reliably. The task sounds like the synthetic key-value retrieval experiment in **"Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts"** (Liu et al., 2023). That paper tests 75, 140 and 300 key-value pairs, and its appendix reports a table of accuracy for each model at each key position.

The broad pattern I remember is this: accuracy for GPT-3.5-Turbo (16K) was near-perfect with fewer pairs. At 300 pairs it dropped noticeably when the key was in the middle of the context, while staying high at the start. I don't remember the exact value at the 200th position, and any specific figure I gave would be a guess.

To get the precise number, check the appendix table for the key-value retrieval results at 300 pairs (arXiv:2307.03172). If you can share the paper or table, I can find the value for you.
